loc.yamijin.room.name: Yamijin's room
loc.yamijin.room.desc: A place packed with Yamijin intel. Don't be shy, read the files to your heart's content.
loc.home.behind_wooden_door.name: Behind the wooden door
loc.home.behind_wooden_door.desc: A room you got into by smashing the wooden door with the busted handle. There's a ton of stuff lying around. Pick it all up!
loc.home.corridor.name: Hallway of {player}'s house
loc.home.corridor.desc: A long hallway running sideways. It leads to all sorts of rooms. It's surprisingly easy to get lost, so watch where you're going.
loc.home.corridor2.name: {player}'s house, hallway 2
loc.home.corridor2.desc: It's supposed to be a hallway, but it's all twisty. Well, you probably won't get lost. It's small.
loc.home.corridor2_return.name: {player}'s house, hallway 2
loc.home.corridor2_return.desc: It's supposed to be a hallway, but it's all twisty. Well, you probably won't get lost. It's small. Wait, you came back from outside? What a wimp.
loc.home.armory.name: Armory?
loc.home.armory.desc: Apparently there are weapons here. But there's no exit leading any further? That's weird.
loc.park.exit.name: Outside the park
loc.park.exit.desc: Just outside the park. As you can probably tell, it's the same area as outside the back door.
loc.park.name: Friendship Park
loc.park.desc: A park where kids play like crazy. It's pretty big, and all kinds of people are relaxing or playing here. Some people are even smoking.
loc.mystery_building.name: The Mystery Building
loc.mystery_building.desc: Where Yamijin's manhole sent you. Your footsteps echo weirdly here. What a creepy place. And apparently some nasty slimes live here.
loc.arkhaia.city.name: Arkhaia City
loc.arkhaia.city.desc: Arkhaia City, the big city. Shops line the streets, and there are fancy houses all over the place. People everywhere.
loc.mansion.name: The Evil Mansion
loc.mansion.desc: Yamijin's headquarters. In other words, the secret hideout. Apparently it's full of scary traps Yamijin made.
loc.home.storeroom.name: Inside the storeroom
loc.home.storeroom.desc: A small storeroom to the right of {player}'s room. Stuff is scattered everywhere, so the floor is a total disaster. But with all that stuff lying around, it might be worth digging through.
loc.home.pool.name: Pool
loc.home.pool.desc: A teeny-tiny pool in {player}'s house. The door is big, but the inside is small. There's a fountain spout, and you often play here in summer.
loc.home.outside.name: Outside {player}'s house
loc.home.outside.desc: Outside {player}'s house. Apparently some fight-loving boy is wandering around. But with a hammer, I'll knock him flat. Heh heh heh heh heh!
loc.town.house.name: Someone's house
loc.town.house.desc: Someone's house near {player}'s house. There are lots of houses around here, and this is one of them. The author couldn't be bothered, so the rooms inside all the houses have the same names. But they're different houses. Now, what's in this one?
loc.town.house_outside.name: Outside the house
loc.town.house_outside.desc: Just outside the house. It's the same as outside {player}'s house. But you just came out of a house, so we changed the area name anyway.
loc.town.back_door_outside.name: Outside the back door
loc.town.back_door_outside.desc: Out the back door of the house. Looks like slightly tougher enemies that aren't human show up here? Wait, whoa, a dragon! A slime! Eeeeek!
loc.town.house_back.name: The house
loc.town.house_back.desc: That house again. Looks like you came back from outside, so no need to explain, right? Just so you know, there's a dresser. (wait, what?)
loc.town.hotel.name: Hotel
loc.town.hotel.desc: An ordinary hotel. Apparently it's surprisingly cheap and comfortable.
loc.town.hotel_outside.name: Outside the hotel
loc.town.hotel_outside.desc: Just outside the hotel. Where those dragons and slimes show up. You know, right?
loc.town.child_house.name: A house
loc.town.child_house.desc: A house in the Friendship Park neighborhood. Apparently lots of families with kids live around here.
loc.town.child_house_outside.name: Outside the house, part 2
loc.town.child_house_outside.desc: Friendship Park is nearby. But why are there dragons and stuff around here?
loc.arkhaia.department.name: Arkhaia Department Store
loc.arkhaia.department.desc: The department store that is the symbol of Arkhaia City. A huge building packed with all kinds of shops.
loc.arkhaia.house.name: A house in Arkhaia City
loc.arkhaia.house.desc: A house in Arkhaia City. That's it.
loc.arkhaia.hotel.name: Hotel
loc.arkhaia.hotel.desc: The hotel in Arkhaia City. A little pricey, but very comfortable.
loc.unknown_land.house.name: The Mystery House
loc.unknown_land.house.desc: A house with computers lined up everywhere. Looks like someone is researching something here.
loc.unknown_land.name: The Unknown Land
loc.unknown_land.desc: The other side of Flame Mountain. An unknown world.
loc.fortress.entrance.name: Yokotank's Fortress, entrance
loc.fortress.name: Yokotank's Fortress
loc.fortress.desc: Yokotank's Fortress. Complete your final mission. Save the world from the food crisis. Stop Yokotank.
